description: Write a post about a topic in a persona's voice (or the user's own trained voice when no persona is given), with a voice-match score. The post is saved for review, not scheduled. Counts against the monthly PersonaForge post allowance.

persona_id.description: Persona UUID — from list_personas. Omit to use the user's own trained voice.

platform.description: Platform to write for, e.g. linkedin or twitter.

topic.description: What the post is about (1–500 characters).

name: generate_persona_post
